description: A view from a small stone platform with a railing and an old green lamp post, looking down a wide river in a town on a sunny autumn day. Two rivers come together here and flow side by side: on the left the water is clear turquoise, on the right it is cloudy grey-brown, with a sharp line where the two touch. A white swan swims into view on the turquoise side and a small boat drifts in on the right. Stone embankments, yellow trees, old houses, a footbridge and snowy mountains are behind.
